title: feat(ui): one 8px corner for every control, a white content area beside a light grey sidebar, and badges at weight 500 (#36047 slice 1)
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuYadPn6DUd9mNCVDjwzayER)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVDwx4yqxWdY3Rurnk

Part of #36047 (slice 1 of 2: theme tokens and shared controls; slice 2, the per-site text sizes and weights, lands last and carries `Fixes`).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 所有控件的圆角统一成 8：按钮、输入框、下拉、工具栏控件、菜单、页签条（原来 12）；列表单元格里的关联小块（原来 4）、表单里选中的人员和关联小块、列表的「排序」「筛选」和已设条件小块（原来全圆）也都是 8。页签条里面的页签按钮、菜单里的一行是 6，和外框同心。
- 卡片仍是 14，弹出框、点击弹出的浮层（选择器等，仍是 20）、抽屉的圆角都不变。鼠标悬停出现的提示框和悬停卡片、下拉列表跟着控件从 12 变 8；弹框和抽屉右上角关闭按钮的小圆角从 10 变 6。单选/多选的彩色标签保持全圆（标签形状未改）。
- 内容区改成白底：列表页、记录页、看板、顶栏都是白的；侧边栏是唯一的浅灰面，和内容区之间有一条细线。深色主题下内容区是最深的一档，侧边栏亮一档。白底范围按 Sales 13:11 的选择：整个控制台都变白（裁定记录 7063106408），不只是列表页和记录页。首页、仪表盘、报表、搜索、通知、文档页、设置和 Studio、登录注册页、公开表单页（`/f/:slug`）、公开分享的记录页（`/s/:token`）的底色也一起变白（它们的布局不动）；设备授权页和首次安装设置页自己用另一种灰，仍是灰底；卡片、弹框本来就是白的，靠描边分开。
- 彩色标签的字重从 600 降到 500（字号、形状、颜色不变）。
- 字号 13→14/12、其他 600→500 不在这个 PR，在片 2，最后落地。

## What changes

**Theme tokens** (`ui/apps/console/src/index.css`, the iOS theme layer)

- `--radius-md: 0.5rem` and `--radius-sm: 0.375rem` are set on `:root`, instead of being derived from `--radius` (`calc(var(--radius) - 2px)` / `- 4px`, which gave 12px and 10px). `--radius` stays 0.875rem, so `rounded-lg` cards keep their 14px corner. The checkbox's own `--radius-sm` override is unchanged.
- What follows the two tokens beyond the controls: tooltips (`TooltipContent`) and hover cards (`HoverCardContent`) are `rounded-md`, so they go 12 → 8px; select and command lists and their rows follow `rounded-md` / `rounded-sm`; the dialog and sheet close buttons (`rounded-sm`) go 10 → 6px. `Popover` content keeps 20px through the console's popper-wrapper rule, so the combobox and lookup pickers are unchanged.
- `--background` is white (`0 0% 100%`, was `240 24% 97%`). The sidebar is `240 12% 96%` (was `240 24% 98%`), drawn at 70% by the frosted rule, so it reads as a light grey beside white; its existing 1px border is the hairline. Dark: `--background` stays `240 6% 6%`, the sidebar is `240 6% 11%` (was 8%), one step lighter.

**Every page whose content background changes** (Sales chose the whole console, ruling of record 7063106408 on #36047, over list and record pages only). `--background` is the console's page canvas, so every page drawn on it goes from the grouped grey to white:

- the top bar (its frosted fill is `--background` at 72%);
- an app's pages: object lists (grid, kanban, calendar, gantt and the other list views), record pages and record drawers, dashboards, reports, the app home;
- the console home, search results, notifications / inbox, the docs pages;
- Setup and Studio pages (their layout is not changed; only the canvas behind them);
- the sign-in, sign-up, password, e-mail-verification and OAuth-consent pages (`AuthShell` / `OAuthConsentPage` draw on `bg-background`); the device-authorization and first-run setup pages draw on `bg-muted` (`240 18% 94%`, unchanged) and stay grey;
- the public form page (`/f/:slug`, `FormPage mode="public"`, which draws no canvas of its own) and the shared-record page (`/s/:token`, `SharedRecordPage` on `bg-background`); the internal `/forms/:name` is an app page;
- inputs, outline buttons and the in-cell editor layer, which were already drawn on `bg-background` and now match the page they sit on.

Cards (`--card`), popovers and dialogs were white already and are unchanged; they are told apart from the page by their border. The sidebar is the one surface that stays grey. In the dark theme the canvas value is unchanged (`240 6% 6%`); only the sidebar moves one step lighter.

**Shared controls**

- `Badge` (`@object-ui/components`, Shadcn-synced) is `font-medium` instead of `font-semibold`, through a declared local patch `badge-medium-weight` in `ui/scripts/shadcn-local-patches.mjs`. The upstream registry file is vendored as `scripts/__tests__/fixtures/shadcn-registry/badge.registry.txt` (pinned sha256, captured at the same shadcn-ui/ui commit as the other fixtures). Round-trip equality is pinned unavailable with its reason: the file already ships the undeclared `whitespace-nowrap` edit. `shadcn-components.json` names the patch.
- Lookup chips in a list cell (`OBJECT_GRID_TABLE_DENSITY` in `@object-ui/plugin-grid`): `rounded` → `rounded-md`.
- The people chip in `LookupField` and the selection tray chip (`@object-ui/fields`): `rounded-full` → `rounded-md`.
- The list's empty Sort / Filter buttons and its condition chips (`ListConditionControls`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`): `rounded-full` → `rounded-md`.

## Why

#36047 items 3 and 4 (maintainer-approved Attio comparison): one corner value for controls, and a white content area with the grey left only to the sidebar, changed on theme variables and shared components rather than page by page. Items 1 and 2 (two text sizes, two weights) are slice 2.

## Verification

Measured in a real browser (CRM example, console dev server against it) before and after, 1440 and 375, light and dark: list (account), record page (opportunity), kanban (opportunity pipeline), create dialog. Computed values, screenshots and the script: `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/36047/` (`before/`, `after/`, `measure.json`, `shots.cjs`).

| | before | after |
|---|---|---|
| buttons, inputs, comboboxes in the content area | 12px (sort/filter pills 9999px) | 8px |
| record page tab triggers | 10px | 6px |
| cards (kanban card, record side card) | 14px / 16px | 14px / 16px |
| create dialog | 20px | 20px (unchanged here; #35980 sets its own) |
| content background, light | rgb(246,246,249) | rgb(255,255,255) |
| sidebar, light | rgba(249,249,251,0.7) | rgba(244,244,246,0.7) |
| content / sidebar, dark | rgb(14,14,16) / rgba(19,19,22,0.7) | rgb(14,14,16) / rgba(26,26,30,0.7) |
| sidebar right border | 1px | 1px |
| badge weight | 600 | 500 |

Tests: `scripts/__tests__/shadcn-local-patches.test.ts` (the new `badge` family: fixture present, hash, anchors apply to registry bytes, marker, round-trip pinned), and every test file that mentions the changed classes or tokens, plus `packages/plugin-list/src` (192 files, 2180 tests, all pass). eslint on the changed files: 0 errors.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (eslint on every changed file locally; CI's Lint UI is the full reading).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the maintainer's summary, in the maintainer's language).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
